meta.name: Projects
meta.description: Projects, tasks, milestones, boards, timelines and workload

permissions.use: See internal projects and work on tasks of the projects you belong to
permissions.portfolioRead: See every project, including private ones
permissions.projectsSync: Write projects through integrations (a project still starts through its proposal approval)
permissions.tasksSync: Write tasks and their comments through integrations

settings.hoursPerWeekHelp: Capacity of a full-time person in the workload view (allocation × hours).
settings.proposalThresholdHoursHelp: Shown when a project starts: larger proposals need the owner's manager. The default approval workflow uses the same number; change both together (Administration → Workflows).

members.title: Members
members.description: Managers edit the project and any task; members work on tasks; viewers read and comment. Allocation is the share of the person’s week planned for this project.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.description: In order; the timeline groups tasks by them.
milestones.name: Milestone name
milestones.deleteBody: Its tasks keep going without a milestone.

danger.title: Archive or delete
danger.archiveHint: Hides it from the portfolio and makes it read-only. You can restore it later.
danger.unarchiveHint: Brings it back to the portfolio and makes it editable again.
danger.archiveBody: Nobody can change it while it is archived.
danger.deleteHint: Deletes the project with its milestones and members.
danger.deleteBlocked: Only empty projects can be deleted (administrators can delete any). Archive it instead.
danger.deleteBody: {count, plural, =0 {This can’t be undone.} one {Its # task is deleted too. This can’t be undone.} other {Its # tasks are deleted too. This can’t be undone.}}

announce.instructions: To pick up a task, press Space or Enter. Use the arrow keys to move it within and between columns. Press Space or Enter again to drop it, or Escape to cancel.

timeline.unscheduled: {count, plural, one {# unscheduled task} other {# unscheduled tasks}}
timeline.unscheduledHint: No start or due date yet. Open one to plan it.

help.title: Using the timeline
help.shift: moves the task one day earlier or later.
help.resize: moves the due date one day.
help.pointer: With a mouse: drag a bar to move it, drag its edges to change the start or due date.
help.summary: Press Enter to open a task. Alt plus left or right arrow moves it by a day; add Shift to change only the due date.

workload.overSummary: {count, plural, one {# person is over-allocated} other {# people are over-allocated}} in these weeks.
workload.emptyHint: Add members with an allocation, and give tasks hours and due dates.
workload.tableLabel: Workload by person and week (scrolls sideways)
workload.caption: Planned hours against capacity per person and week
workload.cellLabel: {person}, week of {week}: {planned} of {capacity} hours planned. Show tasks
workload.unassignedCellLabel: Unassigned work, week of {week}: {planned} hours. Show tasks

approval.title: Proposal approval
approval.needsManager: Planned effort is over {threshold} h, so the owner’s manager approves the start.
approval.automatic: Proposals up to {threshold} h start as soon as they’re submitted.
approval.startHint: Use “Start project” to submit the proposal.
approval.rejected: The proposal was not approved. Adjust it and start again.
approval.detailsHidden: The approval path is visible to the requester, the owner and the approvers.

healthDialog.title: Update health
healthDialog.description: Say how the project is doing. The note shows on the project page and in the portfolio.
healthDialog.notePlaceholder: What changed, and what happens next?

description.on_hold: Nothing is deleted; you can resume it at any time.
description.completed: Completed projects stay in the portfolio as a record.
description.cancelled: A pending proposal approval is withdrawn. This can’t be undone.

form.keyTaken: Another project already uses this key.
form.ownerHint: The project manager; also a manager of the project.
form.datesInvalid: The target date is before the start date.
